children: Grayscale Litecoin Trust (LTC) reported a net decrease in net assets from operations of $(93.6M) for fiscal 2026, reversing a $19.4M net increase in FY2025 and widening from a $(52.3M) decrease in FY2024, driven primarily by a steep decline in the market price of Litecoin (LTC).
Net income: $(93.6M) net decrease in net assets resulting from operations for FY2026, compared with $19.4M net increase in FY2025 and $(52.3M) net decrease in FY2024.
Revenue: Not reported (Trust is a passive vehicle holding LTC; primary activity is changes in fair value of LTC).
Diluted EPS: Not reported in the Form 10-K.
Investment performance: Trust NAV declined 53% in FY2026 as the price of LTC fell from $87.11 to $41.80, materially reducing assets under management.
Operational model: The Trust is a passive, sponsor-managed vehicle that primarily holds LTC; it maintains no cash balances and the Sponsor assumes most expenses to minimize operating outflows.
Creation/redemption activity: Creations added 274k LTC in FY2025; redemptions remain suspended and any future redemptions require SEC approval and Sponsor consent.

Valuation and markets: The Trust switched its reference index to the CoinDesk Litecoin Benchmark Rate on Oct. 1, 2025, selecting principal markets based on volume, AML/KYC compliance, and price stability.
Liquidity and fee payment: Sponsor fees are paid in LTC, which reduced Trust holdings (approximately 49k LTC sold in FY2026); the Trust sells exact LTC to cover expenses to avoid holding cash.
